notes.title: "TORIDAMA2: Brave Challenge" is now available!
notes.notes:
TORIDAMA, the courage-testing game, is back and better than ever!

TORIDAMA features a collection of mini ""chicken"" games.

The number of mini games to diagnose your Chicken Level has been increased to 30!

The game still features the casual and fun gameplay of the previous title, so you can enjoy playing together with friends and family.

Please register and follow us on our Wishlist to receive information about the release of "TORIDAMA2: Brave Challenge"!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2850170/2/
